lines.say: A company sold thirty thousand boxes of actual bullshit.
Black Friday, twenty fourteen. Cards Against Humanity wanted six bucks a box. Gone in under two hours.
The year before, their Black Friday deal was five bucks more fucking expensive.
In twenty fifteen, they sold nothing. You paid five dollars and got jack shit.
Over eleven thousand people paid up. Seventy one thousand dollars, for absolutely nothing.
The staff just split the cash and bought themselves toys. You can't make this shit up.
In twenty sixteen, people chipped in a hundred grand so they could dig a hole. A fucking hole.
caps: so they could dig a hole.

lines.say: No prize, no reason, just a big stupid hole in the ground.
People will pay for bullshit when somebody asks. Your client who vanished? Did anybody even ask?
Message Health spots who's gone quiet, and sends each one a text.
Comment KEEP to get a full retention audit.
